missingFields: Sector times, speed traps and any car telemetry (not included in this dataset)
Pit-lane time loss per circuit (the simulator asks the user for it)
Weather, track temperature and Safety Car / VSC periods
notes: The race was red-flagged on lap 1. Cars changed tyres during the stoppage, so the timing feed records lap-1 'pit stops' lasting ~26 minutes and long early lap times. ApexStint flags these as red-flag stoppages and excludes them from pace baselines.
